28. A method for expressing a gene of interest in a cell, which comprises: (i) contacting the cell with a first polynucleotide and a second polynucleotide as defined in any of claims 1 to 12, wherein at least one of the said polynucleotides encodes a split intein fragment directly linked via a peptide bond to a degron, (ii) allowing the expression of the first and the second polynucleotides so that the first and the second fusion proteins are produced and (iii) allowing the contact between the first and second proteins so that the split intein N-fragment binds to the split intein C-fragment to form an intein intermediate and the intein intermediate reacts to covalently link the C-terminus of the first polypeptide of interest to the N-terminus of the second polypeptide of interest.

29. A method for expressing a gene of interest in a cell, which comprises: (i) contacting the cell with a first polynucleotide and a second polynucleotide as defined in any of claims 13 to 23 wherein both of the said polynucleotides encode a split intein fragment directly linked via a peptide bond to a degron, and (ii) allowing the expression of the first and the second polynucleotides so that the first and the second fusion proteins are produced and (iii) allowing the contact between the first and second proteins so that the split intein N-fragment binds to the split intein C-fragment to form an intein intermediate and the intein intermediate reacts to covalently link the C-terminus of the first polypeptide of interest to the N-terminus of the second polypeptide of interest.
30. The method of any of claims 28 to 29, wherein both polynucleotides are comprised within adeno associated viruses (AAV).
